blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines— A 26-year-old person deprived of liberty (PDL), also another name for an inmate, died after he was electrocuted while taking a bath inside the comfort room of the Argao District Jail on Tuesday evening, October 20, 2026. Authorities said the dead inmate was a resident of Barili town in southwestern Cebu. According to the Argao Municipal Police Station, the victim’s sister called authorities at around 1:10 AM on Wednesday, October 21, to report the incident involving her brother.
